purpose: Make visual assets specific, intuitive, platform-native and recognizably connected to the client instead of generic AI-looking templates.

preferred_workflow: inspect the real business profile/site and available brand assets
define the audience, campaign goal, single key message and measurable next action
create a specific art direction and choose the intended output format
use Canva Magic Media / Canva AI to generate a custom visual element when it improves the concept
compose and refine the design in Canva with editable text, grid, hierarchy and intentional spacing
use Magic Design as a layout starting point only when the brief and content are specific enough
review mobile legibility, factual accuracy, visual artifacts and platform crop before export

use_for: unavailable specific visual that stock search cannot provide
if_results_are_generic: change the visual concept and camera/composition, not just adjectives
describe what must be visible and where negative space should remain
generate a new variation from the complete prompt

magic_design.use_when: The page structure, copy, audience and goal are known and Canva can use them to suggest a composition.
magic_design.do_not_use_as: A substitute for market research, art direction, custom visual assets or quality review.

anti_artificial_visuals: avoid generic purple-blue gradients, random glowing blobs, floating glass cards and decorative 3D icons unless the brand/concept genuinely calls for them
avoid excessive shadows, outlines, glow, bevel, fake depth and layers that do not improve hierarchy
avoid stock-photo sameness, plastic skin, impossible reflections, warped fingers, malformed tools, inconsistent product geometry and synthetic food texture
do not default every business to black-and-gold luxury styling
prefer believable light, tactile materials, natural imperfections and context-specific details
use a strong but restrained focal point rather than filling every empty area

instagram_feed_portrait.use: single feed post with a clear hierarchy

instagram_square.use: square grid or multi-platform reuse when requested

instagram_story.use: story sequence, promotion or vertical narrative

whatsapp_status.use: status creative readable on a phone screen

whatsapp_share_card.use: shareable image shown inside a chat; keep copy minimal

quality_gate: A viewer can identify the business/category and message within two seconds.
The main message remains readable at phone size without zooming.
The design has one obvious focal point and a clear reading order.
The CTA is visible, specific and points to a real confirmed channel.
The offer, price, address, dates, results and claims match evidence.
The image subject, composition and palette fit this client rather than a reusable generic template.
Generated visual artifacts are inspected; a bad AI image is replaced, not excused.
Spacing, margins, contrast, crop and alignment are consistent.
The editable copy is not baked into the generated photo/element.
The export dimensions and crop fit the destination platform.

platform_adaptation.instagram: Use a thumb-stopping focal point, short hierarchy and crop-safe content; do not turn every post into a price poster.
platform_adaptation.whatsapp: Make the message understandable at a glance, keep copy short, make the reply/order action obvious, and avoid sending a wall of text as an image.
platform_adaptation.website_or_landing_page: Prioritize clear information scent, scan-friendly sections, real proof and a visible next action over decorative effects.
platform_adaptation.presentation: Build one idea per page with a visual that explains the idea, not a stock image added to fill space.
platform_adaptation.other: Inspect the target platform's current format and constraints before composing or exporting.
